key: COREY: So you came.
en: COREY: So you came.
ja: コーリー: 来たか

key: Good.
en: Good.
ja: よかろう

key: I had deigned to hope you would.
en: I had deigned to hope you would.
ja: 来ることを　願ってしまっていた

key: Hope is weakness.
en: Hope is weakness.
ja: 希望は　弱さだ

key: It's an illusion meant to sugarcoat this sickening reality.
en: It's an illusion meant to sugarcoat this sickening reality.
ja: この　吐き気のする現実を　甘く見せるための　幻にすぎない

key: And I am weak.
en: And I am weak.
ja: そして　私は　弱い

key: The sooner one gets used to the idea that life is a nightmare, the better off they'll be.
en: The sooner one gets used to the idea that life is a nightmare, the better off they'll be.
ja: 人生は　悪夢だと　早く慣れた者ほど　楽になれる

key: I've simply raised my daughter keeping that in mind.
en: I've simply raised my daughter keeping that in mind.
ja: 私は　それを　心に留めて　娘を　育ててきただけだ

key: My circumstances are evidence enough of its truth,
en: My circumstances are evidence enough of its truth,
ja: 私の境遇こそ　その証だ、

key: And a product of my own mistakes.
en: And a product of my own mistakes.
ja: そして　私自身の　過ちの結果でもある

key: Now that I was forced to prioritize her safety, mine is kaput.
en: Now that I was forced to prioritize her safety, mine is kaput.
ja: 娘の安全を　優先せざるを得なかった今　私の安全は　もう　おしまいだ

key: But for my final few moments of freedom, I have a task for you.
en: But for my final few moments of freedom, I have a task for you.
ja: だが　残された　わずかな自由の間に　おまえに　頼みがある

key: First, show me your strength.
en: First, show me your strength.
ja: まずは　その力を　見せてみろ

key: Take your place and prove to me that you are not entirely unworthy of it.
en: Take your place and prove to me that you are not entirely unworthy of it.
ja: 位置に　つけ。まるきり　値しない相手ではないと　証明してみせろ

key: COREY: I will bar nothing.
en: COREY: I will bar nothing.
ja: コーリー: 手加減は　しない

key: My hand has been forced.
en: My hand has been forced.
ja: 私に　選ぶ余地は　ない

key: The only reason I've kept going through the years was for Heather.
en: The only reason I've kept going through the years was for Heather.
ja: この年月　私が　生きてこられたのは　ヘザーのためだけだ

key: She was my singular denial.
en: She was my singular denial.
ja: あの子だけが　私の　唯一の否定だった

key: My one hope, and memory of her...
en: My one hope, and memory of her...
ja: ただひとつの希望　そして　あの人の　面影……

key: And now just like that, the small splinter of a life I had rebuilt has been broken.
en: And now just like that, the small splinter of a life I had rebuilt has been broken.
ja: そして　あっけなく　築き直した　小さな暮らしの　かけらも　砕けた

key: I should have expected nothing less.
en: I should have expected nothing less.
ja: はじめから　こうなると　思うべきだった

key: As her father, I cannot do something that would put her in danger.
en: As her father, I cannot do something that would put her in danger.
ja: 父として　あの子を　危険に　さらすことは　できない

key: But as "Borealis", I cannot be allowed to let Team Meteor's opponents run free.
en: But as "Borealis", I cannot be allowed to let Team Meteor's opponents run free.
ja: だが　「ボレアリス」として　メテオだんの　敵を　野放しには　できない

key: These two roles could never co-exist, and especially not now.
en: These two roles could never co-exist, and especially not now.
ja: この二つの役は　決して　両立しない。今は　なおさらだ

key: One of them must be struck down.
en: One of them must be struck down.
ja: どちらかを　討ち滅ぼすしかない

key: \PN,
en: \PN,
ja: \PN

key: COREY: Pray this is not futile.
en: COREY: Pray this is not futile.
ja: コーリー: これが　むだで　ないことを　祈れ

key: Prove to me that you're ready to face the cruelty of what is real.
en: Prove to me that you're ready to face the cruelty of what is real.
ja: 現実の　むごさに　向き合う覚悟が　あると　証明してみせろ

key: COREY: You failed already; what use is there in trying again?
en: COREY: You failed already; what use is there in trying again?
ja: コーリー: すでに　敗れたのだ。もう一度　挑んで　何になる?

key: But it is a rite of youth to again and again break one's spirits upon the crags of life.
en: But it is a rite of youth to again and again break one's spirits upon the crags of life.
ja: だが　人生の岩肌に　何度も　心を　砕くのは　若さの　通過儀礼か

key: COREY: Allow me to spare you the trouble.
en: COREY: Allow me to spare you the trouble.
ja: コーリー: その手間は　私が　省いてやろう

key: And so all is vanished.
en: And so all is vanished.
ja: こうして　すべては　消えた

key: ...Good.
en: ...Good.
ja: ……それでいい

key: COREY: That will be adequate.
en: COREY: That will be adequate.
ja: コーリー: それで　十分だ

key: Consider "Borealis" vanquished.
en: Consider "Borealis" vanquished.
ja: 「ボレアリス」は　討たれたと　思え

key: ...By now, Sirius will already have been informed of my supposed betrayal anyway.
en: ...By now, Sirius will already have been informed of my supposed betrayal anyway.
ja: ……どのみち　シリウスには　私の裏切りとやらが　もう　伝わっているだろう

key: He will use Heather to control me, as he has, for all of these years.
en: He will use Heather to control me, as he has, for all of these years.
ja: あいつは　これまでと　同じように　ヘザーを　使って　私を　操る

key: My request to you is simply to keep her safe.
en: My request to you is simply to keep her safe.
ja: おまえへの　頼みは　ただ　あの子を　守ることだ

key: HEATHER: Hey!
en: HEATHER: Hey!
ja: ヘザー: ちょっと!

key: COREY: You're awake already...
en: COREY: You're awake already...
ja: コーリー: もう　目を覚ましたのか……

key: HEATHER: I heard that.
en: HEATHER: I heard that.
ja: ヘザー: 聞こえてたんだから

key: What do you mean, "use me to control you"?
en: What do you mean, "use me to control you"?
ja: 「アタシを使って　操る」って　どういうこと?

key: I heard everything from the officers.
en: I heard everything from the officers.
ja: 警官の人たちから　全部　聞いたんだから

key: I think it's about time you start answering my questions.
en: I think it's about time you start answering my questions.
ja: そろそろ　アタシの質問に　答えてくれても　いいでしょ

key: COREY: ...Careless fools.
en: COREY: ...Careless fools.
ja: コーリー: ……浅はかな　連中だ

key: No regard for the mental health of a child...
en: No regard for the mental health of a child...
ja: 子どもの　心の健康など　考えもしない……

key: HEATHER: If you're so concerned about my mental health then maybe you should actually TALK TO ME for ONCE in your LIFE!
en: HEATHER: If you're so concerned about my mental health then maybe you should actually TALK TO ME for ONCE in your LIFE!
ja: ヘザー: アタシの心の健康が　そんなに心配なら　一生に一度くらい　ちゃんと　話してよ!

key: COREY: I... have made some mistakes.
en: COREY: I... have made some mistakes.
ja: コーリー: 私は……いくつか　過ちを　犯した

key: HEATHER: You THINK?
en: HEATHER: You THINK?
ja: ヘザー: 今さら?

key: "Oh, oops! I joined a secret evil team destroying the region, whoopsie-daisy!"
en: "Oh, oops! I joined a secret evil team destroying the region, whoopsie-daisy!"
ja: 「おっと　うっかり! 地方を　こわす　秘密の悪の組織に　入っちゃった　てへっ!」

key: Some mistake!
en: Some mistake!
ja: たいした　過ちだこと!

key: And to think you've been lecturing me this whole time on being safe--
en: And to think you've been lecturing me this whole time on being safe--
ja: しかも　ずっと　アタシに　安全がどうのって　説教してたなんて——

key: What, just to hide the truth from me?!
en: What, just to hide the truth from me?!
ja: 何? 本当のことを　隠すため!?

key: COREY: That's not it at all--
en: COREY: That's not it at all--
ja: コーリー: そうではない——

key: HEATHER: I don't wanna hear your lies anymore!
en: HEATHER: I don't wanna hear your lies anymore!
ja: ヘザー: もう　うそなんて　聞きたくない!

key: What do you mean "keep me safe"?!
en: What do you mean "keep me safe"?!
ja: 「アタシを守る」って　何なのよ!?

key: I can take care of myself!
en: I can take care of myself!
ja: 自分のことくらい　自分で　できるもん!

key: COREY: You were rushed here, utterly defeated and altogether laid out mere moments ago.
en: COREY: You were rushed here, utterly defeated and altogether laid out mere moments ago.
ja: コーリー: ついさっき　おまえは　完全に　打ちのめされて　ここへ　運びこまれた

key: Your headstrong impudence will be your end.
en: Your headstrong impudence will be your end.
ja: その　強情な生意気さが　おまえの身を　滅ぼす

key: HEATHER: The woman I was fighting cheated!
en: HEATHER: The woman I was fighting cheated!
ja: ヘザー: 戦ってた女が　ズルしたんだもん!

key: She--
en: She--
ja: あいつ——

key: ...That was your Crobat.
en: ...That was your Crobat.
ja: ……あれ　パパの　クロバットだった

key: COREY: ...You were still conscious.
en: COREY: ...You were still conscious.
ja: コーリー: ……意識が　あったのか

key: HEATHER: Why was that your Crobat?!
en: HEATHER: Why was that your Crobat?!
ja: ヘザー: なんで　パパの　クロバットだったの!?

key: COREY: Please calm down.
en: COREY: Please calm down.
ja: コーリー: 落ち着きなさい

key: HEATHER: You were there-- why were you there?!
en: HEATHER: You were there-- why were you there?!
ja: ヘザー: そこに　いたんでしょ——なんで　いたのよ!?

key: COREY: Heather--
en: COREY: Heather--
ja: コーリー: ヘザー——

key: HEATHER: Why do you ALWAYS refuse to tell me anything?!
en: HEATHER: Why do you ALWAYS refuse to tell me anything?!
ja: ヘザー: どうして　いつも　何ひとつ　教えてくれないの!?

key: If I don't push it, you won't tell me, and if I do push it you just tell me "Calm down," "Not right now--"
en: If I don't push it, you won't tell me, and if I do push it you just tell me "Calm down," "Not right now--"
ja: 問い詰めなきゃ　言わないし　問い詰めれば　「落ち着け」「今は　だめだ」ばっかり——

key: COREY: I am trying to keep you safe!
en: COREY: I am trying to keep you safe!
ja: コーリー: おまえを　守ろうと　しているのだ!

key: HEATHER: From WHAT?!
en: HEATHER: From WHAT?!
ja: ヘザー: 何から!?

key: Yourself?!
en: Yourself?!
ja: パパ自身から!?

key: But apparently YOU'RE being controlled by ME?!
en: But apparently YOU'RE being controlled by ME?!
ja: なのに　パパは　アタシに　操られてるって!?

key: No, forget it.
en: No, forget it.
ja: もう　いい

key: I'm leaving.
en: I'm leaving.
ja: アタシ　出ていく

key: COREY: Excuse me?
en: COREY: Excuse me?
ja: コーリー: 何だと?

key: HEATHER: For good.
en: HEATHER: For good.
ja: ヘザー: 二度と　戻らない

key: And you KNOW you can't stop me.
en: And you KNOW you can't stop me.
ja: 止められないって　わかってるでしょ

key: COREY: Heather, you will stop this right now.
en: COREY: Heather, you will stop this right now.
ja: コーリー: ヘザー　今すぐ　やめなさい

key: HEATHER: Make me!
en: HEATHER: Make me!
ja: ヘザー: やめさせてみなよ!

key: You can't!
en: You can't!
ja: できっこない!

key: What even is the point if I'm just a burden to you anyway?!
en: What even is the point if I'm just a burden to you anyway?!
ja: どうせ　アタシは　じゃま者なんでしょ。意味ないじゃん!

key: I'm done listening to you and your stupid rules!
en: I'm done listening to you and your stupid rules!
ja: パパの　くだらない決まりごとなんて　もう　聞かない!

key: I'm sick of you saying I can't do anything ever!
en: I'm sick of you saying I can't do anything ever!
ja: 何も　できないって　言われるの　もう　うんざり!

key: I should've left a long time ago!
en: I should've left a long time ago!
ja: とっくに　出ていけば　よかった!

key: So I'm done.
en: So I'm done.
ja: だから　もう　終わり

key: Bye.
en: Bye.
ja: さよなら

key: COREY: You're being completely irresponsible.
en: COREY: You're being completely irresponsible.
ja: コーリー: まったく　無責任だ

key: You can't just fly away and hope all of your problems will be solved.
en: You can't just fly away and hope all of your problems will be solved.
ja: 飛んで逃げれば　悩みが　すべて　消えるわけでは　ない

key: HEATHER: Watch me.
en: HEATHER: Watch me.
ja: ヘザー: 見てなさいよ

key: COREY: Heather!
en: COREY: Heather!
ja: コーリー: ヘザー!

key: HEATHER: What.
en: HEATHER: What.
ja: ヘザー: なによ

key: COREY: You took your mother's ring again, did you not?
en: COREY: You took your mother's ring again, did you not?
ja: コーリー: また　母さんの指輪を　持ち出したな?

key: HEATHER: So what if I did?
en: HEATHER: So what if I did?
ja: ヘザー: だったら　なによ?

key: COREY: ...Don't lose it.
en: COREY: ...Don't lose it.
ja: コーリー: ……なくすなよ

key: COREY: So that's it.
en: COREY: So that's it.
ja: コーリー: これで　終わりか

key: Twelve years of torment... just for her to vanish just as quickly.
en: Twelve years of torment... just for her to vanish just as quickly.
ja: 十二年の　苦しみ……それが　あっけなく　消えていく

key: No...
en: No...
ja: いや……

key: I suppose it's come to an end.
en: I suppose it's come to an end.
ja: 終わりが　来たということだろう

key: COREY: \PN.
en: COREY: \PN.
ja: コーリー: \PN

key: I'm in no place to ask you for any more favors, so...
en: I'm in no place to ask you for any more favors, so...
ja: これ以上　頼みごとを　できる立場では　ないから……

key: I'll put it this way:
en: I'll put it this way:
ja: こう　言っておく

key: Come to Beryl Bridge if you want a show.
en: Come to Beryl Bridge if you want a show.
ja: 見物したいなら　ベリル大橋へ　来い
